new_alignment_findings.contract: Logistics barrel cover data has world-save consumers but no effective normal client-update consumer.
new_alignment_findings.evidence: TankBlockEntity overrides getCover, so fallback uses/track=false. Inherited getUpdateTag omits logistics faces; native getUpdatePacket is null. Save/load and final harvested cover data are separate positive paths.

new_alignment_findings.contract: Dedicated LOGISTICS_TANK type is omitted from both renderer registrations.
new_alignment_findings.evidence: TankCoverRenderer can draw logistics faces but is registered only for ordinary TANK; native dispatcher keys by exact getType, and fallback rendering visits only its tracked hosts.

source_equivalence.changes: Whitespace only. No normalization, gameplay, comments, directives, imports or identifiers changed.

earlier_readability_checkpoint.scope: Previously committed five-source/nine-view checkpoint; not new edits in batch 87.

bounded_family_projection.limits: Declared builtin family labels only. Does not execute Java, ore membership, tags, all materials, components, units, extraction or external providers.

renderer_declaration_inventory.limits: Current maintained production source calls only; excludes addons, injected third-party renderers and actual event execution.

root_revalidation.method: Rehash named evidence and selected platform sources; compare complete ordered code and original literal positions; inspect native packet/renderer method bodies; verify ledger sequence and added local links.
